content.comment_body: Hello, I have a project with several different functions. I am facing a small issue: There are 7 digital inputs. Whenever two or more of these inputs are activated, I want a digital output to turn ON. What is the best way to implement this?
Please try the solution provided in the attachment.

analysis.insight_summary: The user is looking for a straightforward way to configure logic so that a digital output is ON when two or more digital inputs are active. The limited response, which only refers to an attachment, highlights a lack of clear documentation or guidance for setting up this logic with [company_name] products. The available support and documentation for this situation seem insufficient or unclear.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects [company_name] products to provide a simple and transparent method for configuring digital logic, specifically to enable an output when two or more inputs are active.
